senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. David, King of Israel.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 4a:14">Ber. 4ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>בן ד׳</he> or <he>ד׳</he> (= <cite ref="M02870"><he>משיח</he></cite>) the son of David (the David of the future), the redeemer of Israel from captivity.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25a:9">R. Hash. 25ᵃ</cite> (a secret watchword) <he>ד׳ מלך וכ׳</he> David, the King of Israel, is alive &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:10">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top.
